_about: 351 Watch New York pilot: agenda platform and crawlable listing per tracked board, or the precise reason a town is not automated. Same per-town schema as towns_ma_all.json plus state, agenda_platform and why the town was chosen (selection_reason / selection_source_url). Built by `python3 experiments/ny_pilot.py discover` (watch351.discover_census with NY board names) and hand curation (CURATED in experiments/ny_pilot.py). Listings with "platform": "generic_ny" or "escribe" use the adapters added for this pilot.
evidence_rule: discovery: board automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda dated in [today-120d, today+120d]; curated listings were checked by hand
